Randall Carlson gives his take on Atlantis in this Joe Rogan Experience segment devoted to the lost continent. Carlson, who studies ancient catastrophes, reads Plato's story as a memory of a real drowned world. Floods and comets do the destroying in his account of the tale.

Carlson links the Atlantis story to the sudden warming and flooding at the end of the Ice Age. He argues a rich culture could have vanished under rising seas with little trace left. Rogan asks where such a city would sit and what proof remains. The curious and the bold get Carlson's full version of the drowned world.
